2610.11381.title: EvoKnow: Continual Knowledge Evolution for AI-Generated Image Detection
2610.11381.paper_summary: AI-generated image detectors are commonly trained on fixed generator domains and become difficult to maintain as new generative models emerge. Continual adaptation is challenging because replaying historical generated images is costly, whereas updating shared parameters with limited current-domain data can overwrite prior forensic knowledge. We propose EvoKnow, a replay-free framework that formulates continual AI-generated image detection as forensic knowledge evolution. EvoKnow preserves a shared forensic basis learned from base domains, incrementally adds isolated residual experts for complementary generator-relevant evidence, and retrieves expertise through an Analytical Incremental Router (AIR) updated in closed form from current-stage generated images and accumulated sufficient statistics. Experiments demonstrate effective cross-generator generalization, few-shot expansion, and long-horizon continual adaptation. With ten generated images per arriving generator, EvoKnow achieves 96.70% average accuracy on non-base GenImage generators and 94.48% accuracy on Chameleon without target-benchmark adaptation. Under a strict replay-free continual learning protocol, EvoKnow achieves state-of-the-art continual learning performance, attaining 96.32% mean stage-wise accuracy and 4.32% average forgetting.
2610.11381.paper_summary_zh: AI 生成圖像檢測器通常是在固定的生成器領域上訓練的，隨著新的生成模型的出現，維護變得困難。持續適應是具有挑戰性的，因為重播歷史生成的圖像成本高昂，而用有限的當前領域數據更新共享參數可能會覆蓋先前的法醫知識。我們提出了 EvoKnow，一個無需重播的框架，將持續的 AI 生成圖像檢測公式化為法醫知識的演變。EvoKnow 保留了從基礎領域學習的共享法醫基礎，逐步添加孤立的殘差專家以提供互補的生成器相關證據，並通過從當前階段生成的圖像和累積的充分統計中以閉合形式更新的分析增量路由器 (AIR) 檢索專業知識。實驗顯示出有效的跨生成器泛化、少量擴展和長期持續適應。對於每個到達的生成器，EvoKnow 在非基礎 GenImage 生成器上達到了 96.70% 的平均準確率，並在 Chameleon 上達到了 94.48% 的準確率，無需目標基準適應。在嚴格的無重播持續學習協議下，EvoKnow 實現了最先進的持續學習性能，達到 96.32% 的平均階段準確率和 4.32% 的平均遺忘率。
